_README: Project-scoped MCP servers for ad-hoc company research in Claude Code (target B). These complement the in-process news/social tools wired into the RAG backend (rag/server.py). All are free-tier. Fill in the env values, then verify each launches with `/mcp` inside Claude Code. Package names are the current community/official servers; if one fails to start, check its repo for the exact npx/uvx identifier. No Playwright/WSJ here by design (ban risk on the subscription account).
